verdict.rationale: Kushki has a first-party docs page on 'Returns, cancellations, and refunds' under card payments, so it documents its own refund/void capability. The pack shows only the page title, with no detail on amounts or channels. Missing for 10: evidence of partial vs full refund support, evidence of refunds from the dashboard, evidence of a refund API endpoint or request details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
